environment.dateScope: 2026-10-18 America/Chicago; execution and current UTC inventory audits occur 2026-10-19.
environment.caches: Pinned existing dependencies with isolated writable caches, --disable-sandbox and local host support for sockets, hardware metadata and release debug-symbol generation.
environment.isolation: Concurrent development/compiler/validation and cache-soak workloads. Timing isolation and controlled performance-regression attribution are not qualified.

implementationScope: Independent downstream DiscordDSLBenchmarks package compares handwritten routes and real DSL lowering through the same captured typed schema, handler, CommandRouter and InteractionResponder. No runtime product selects benchmark or compiler tooling.

Default matrix performs one million invocations per direct/DSL path at 10/100/1000 declarations, finite payload and concurrency, bounded prefix quantiles and actual RSS/live allocator/accounted-state observations.

Hard gates require exact registration/callback parity, schema capture once per declared handler, finite worker/sample/payload/input counts, no implicit hydration/registration construction and zero final active ownership. Tests cover malformed configuration and success/failure/cancellation cleanup.

Separate generated manual/macro external consumers measure clean consumer and controlled incremental build costs on the same compiler. Dependency/plugin bootstrap is separate, source edits restore and compiled catalogs verify exact finite route counts without running handlers.

First observations precede separately derived finite 10-percent budgets with explicit timing/memory floors. Complete matrices, real duration, monotonic bounded observations, schema/accounting/cleanup invariants and exact hardware/compiler/workload identity fail closed. Self-check establishes wiring only.
Existing cache/broadcast profiles and 1800-second soak remain separate from paired 60-second handler observations. Source/executable hashes and interference limitations are retained.

Callable documentation, graph/import isolation, strict benchmark tests, CI smoke/artifact collection, adoption/status docs and append-only parity history cover the development package. Scoped target system imports admit only reviewed platform modules.
sourceReviewScope: No new Discord wire contract, upstream collection or semantic source review. Existing official review records govern unchanged composed contracts; inventory classifications are unchanged.

documentationScope.limitation: Syntactic documentation presence, curated examples and DocC conversion do not prove semantic completeness.

apiScope: No runtime API change in dsl benchmarks. Current 0.15.0 candidate comparison to frozen 0.14.0 retains the pre-existing 1010 additions, zero changed/removed symbols and zero removed relationships. The checked pre-1.0 minor version rule accepts 0.15.0; no binary ABI or other-platform certification.

independentReview.runtime: Reviewed configuration, direct/DSL routes, schema/worker/sample bounds, process gauges, successful/failure/cancellation cleanup and tests; no blocking findings.
independentReview.compiler: Reviewed generated manual/macro consumers, dependency bootstrap separation, clean-output handling, incremental restoration, timing/RSS scope and tests.
resolvedFindings: Runtime evidence validator now enforces Swift config bounds and actual configured duration.
Runtime throughput must match completed work and elapsed time.
Bounded monotonic memory observations are required and their maxima budgeted.
Duplicate JSON keys and unavailable baseline identity values are rejected.
Compiler ru_maxrss and concurrent workload limitations are explicit.

qualificationLimits: Local macOS arm64 Swift 6.4 offline/synthetic evidence only; no authorized Discord, hardware/device, other-platform or production/fleet qualification.

First baseline only; a matching self-check is not a previous-implementation comparison. Concurrent work, prefix latency samples, fixed order and allocator history prevent controlled attribution. Investigate greater-than-10-percent regressions reproduced in three matching runs.

Plan timing includes schema/definition construction, lowering and router admission; excludes fixed interaction parsing. Invocation timing includes instrumentation, fresh ownership and callback validation.

Runtime RSS/CPU/live allocations are process-wide gauges, not cumulative allocations or exact per-plan heap sizes. Accounted JSON/counts describe finite logical/transient author state. Zero active ownership is not entire-process zero growth.

Compiler clean builds retain dependencies/plugin; one sample per clean/incremental operation includes planning/codegen/link. Native backend measurements omit its optional explicit-import checker; independent repository graph/import audit passes.

Runtime handler evidence uses normalized contexts and initial replies only. It does not measure signed HTTP ingress, Gateway event-host throughput, other response families or supervised network sessions.
Full dsl documentation/migration and release certification remain authoring release; optional service, distributed coordinator, keyed-store and live-registration gates are unchanged.
